Paged text buffer inspired by Kestrel-style pooled page writers. Optimized for repeated HTML rendering without building one giant string.Returns hit, miss, and retention metrics for the shared page pool.Resets the page pool hit and miss counters.Returns the current page pool retention policy.Trims the shared page pool down to retainPages pages or retainBytes bytes.Configures the page pool retention limits and optionally trims immediately.Initializes a PageBuffer that draws pages of pageSize bytes from the shared pool.Pre-acquire count pages for buf from the shared pool to reduce page growth churn in hot render paths.Appends text into buf across pooled pages.Append raw bytes from the external memory region src into the paged buffer buf.Append raw bytes from src into the Nim string dst without intermediate copies.Ensure at least requiredBytes contiguous free bytes on the current page of buf; returns false when requiredBytes exceeds the page size.Copy raw bytes from src directly into the current page of buf; caller must ensure contiguous capacity first.Reserve requiredBytes contiguous bytes on the current page of buf and return the destination pointer, or nil when the request is invalid.Append text directly into the current page of buf; caller must ensure contiguous capacity first.Appends the slice of text between startPos and endPos into buf.Appends the single character c into buf.Encode integer n as ASCII digits into caller-provided storage and return the active window.Appends the decimal ASCII representation of n into buf.Scans raw text and returns true when it contains characters needing HTML escaping.Appends text into buf with HTML special characters escaped.Appends the raw text at textPtr into buf with HTML special characters escaped.Appends the escaped raw text at textPtr directly into the Nim string dst.Returns true when buf holds its data on exactly one page.Returns a pointer and length for the used region of the first page.Writes each used page through writeSegment and returns false on the first failure.Writes each used page through the raw writeSegment callback without string conversion.Joins all buffered page data into a single string and resets buf.Resets all page usage counters in buf without releasing the pages.Returns the pages of buf to the shared pool up to its retention limits.
